title: small businesses
meaning_vi: doanh nghiệp nhỏ

examples.en: Government-funded public festivals often generate valuable revenue for small businesses in the local area.

title: tax revenues
meaning_vi: nguồn thu từ thuế

examples.en: A significant share of tax revenues is channelled into public education and healthcare each year.

title: cost-inefficient
meaning_vi: không hiệu quả về chi phí

examples.en: Duplicated bureaucratic departments are often cost-inefficient and drain public funds.

title: economical toll
meaning_vi: gánh nặng kinh tế

examples.en: Prolonged lockdowns took a severe economical toll on small retailers across the country.

title: enduring debt
meaning_vi: khoản nợ kéo dài

examples.en: Excessive government borrowing can leave a country with enduring debt that burdens future generations.

title: financial sustainability
meaning_vi: tính bền vững tài chính

examples.en: Without reform, the pension scheme's financial sustainability will be seriously undermined within a decade.

title: generates less economic value to society
term: generates less economic value to society
meaning_vi: tạo ra ít giá trị kinh tế hơn cho xã hội

examples.en: Critics claim that funding folk museums generates less economic value to society than funding technology parks.

title: household debt
meaning_vi: nợ hộ gia đình

examples.en: Government subsidies for essential goods can help reduce household debt among low-income families.

title: lavish outlays
meaning_vi: những khoản chi tiêu xa hoa

examples.en: Opponents claim that lavish outlays on national celebrations divert funds from more urgent public needs.

title: loss of cultural diversity
meaning_vi: sự mất mát tính đa dạng văn hóa

examples.en: Cutting arts funding risks a loss of cultural diversity as minority traditions fade from public life.

title: opportunity cost
meaning_vi: chi phí cơ hội

examples.en: The opportunity cost of funding lavish festivals is a reduction in spending on healthcare and education.

title: pressing challenge
meaning_vi: thách thức cấp bách

examples.en: Rising unemployment remains a pressing challenge that the new cabinet must address immediately.

title: severely strain public budgets
meaning_vi: gây áp lực nặng nề lên ngân sách công

examples.en: An ageing population can severely strain public budgets allocated to pensions and healthcare.

title: exert disadvantageous impacts
meaning_vi: gây ra những tác động bất lợi

examples.en: Unregulated markets can exert disadvantageous impacts on small local producers.

title: allocate a substantial portion of their budget to
term: allocate a substantial portion of their budget to
pronunciation: /ˈæləkeɪt ə səbˈstænʃəl ˈpɔːʃən əv ðeə ˈbʌdʒɪt tuː/
meaning_vi: phân bổ một phần đáng kể ngân sách cho

examples.en: Many governments allocate a substantial portion of their budget to public healthcare and education systems.

title: allocate more financial resources
meaning_vi: phân bổ thêm nguồn lực tài chính

examples.en: The council has pledged to allocate more financial resources to rural clinics next year.

title: allocate public funds
meaning_vi: phân bổ ngân sách công

examples.en: The council decided to allocate public funds to renovating the city's ageing water pipes.

title: appropriate incentives such as tax breaks or expedited permit processes
term: appropriate incentives such as tax breaks or expedited permit processes
pronunciation: /əˈprəʊpriət ɪnˈsɛntɪvz sʌtʃ æz tæks breɪks ɔː ɪkˈspɛdɪtɪd ˈpɜːmɪt ˈprəʊsɛsɪz/
meaning_vi: các ưu đãi thích hợp như giảm thuế hoặc rút ngắn thủ tục cấp phép

examples.en: To attract developers, the city offered appropriate incentives such as tax breaks or expedited permit processes.

title: areas with more immediate societal impacts
term: areas with more immediate societal impacts
meaning_vi: những lĩnh vực có tác động xã hội trực tiếp hơn

examples.en: Critics argue that public money should target areas with more immediate societal impacts, such as healthcare and education.

title: attract foreign direct investments
meaning_vi: thu hút đầu tư trực tiếp nước ngoài

examples.en: A stable legal system helps a country attract foreign direct investments more easily.

title: financial stability
meaning_vi: sự ổn định tài chính

examples.en: Prudent fiscal policy is essential for maintaining the financial stability of a nation's economy.

title: foreign direct investment
meaning_vi: đầu tư trực tiếp nước ngoài

examples.en: Tax incentives were introduced specifically to attract more foreign direct investment.

title: generate substantial revenue
meaning_vi: tạo ra nguồn thu đáng kể

examples.en: Cultural festivals sponsored by the government can generate substantial revenue through tourism.

title: governmental allocation of financial resources
meaning_vi: việc phân bổ nguồn lực tài chính của chính phủ

examples.en: Debate continues over the governmental allocation of financial resources between foreign aid and domestic welfare.

title: improve economic growth
meaning_vi: cải thiện tăng trưởng kinh tế

examples.en: Targeted infrastructure spending is one of the most effective ways to improve economic growth.

title: improve employment and tax revenue
meaning_vi: cải thiện việc làm và nguồn thu thuế

examples.en: New manufacturing plants improve employment and tax revenue in rural areas.

title: increase their nation's economic stability
meaning_vi: gia tăng sự ổn định kinh tế quốc gia

examples.en: Diversifying export industries can help countries increase their nation's economic stability.

title: increases the economic growth rate
meaning_vi: làm tăng tốc độ tăng trưởng kinh tế

examples.en: Government spending on education typically increases the economic growth rate over the long term.

title: levy higher taxes on the ownership of multiple properties
term: levy higher taxes on the ownership of multiple properties
pronunciation: /ˈlɛvi ˈhaɪə ˈtæksɪz ɒn ði ˈəʊnəʃɪp əv ˈmʌltɪpl ˈprɒpətiz/
meaning_vi: đánh thuế cao hơn đối với việc sở hữu nhiều bất động sản

examples.en: To curb speculation, the government proposed to levy higher taxes on the ownership of multiple properties.

title: redirect funds from art to education
term: redirect funds from art to education
meaning_vi: chuyển ngân sách từ nghệ thuật sang giáo dục

examples.en: Facing budget cuts, the council decided to redirect funds from art to education instead.

title: technological spin-off
meaning_vi: sản phẩm phụ công nghệ

examples.en: Government-funded space programmes have produced numerous technological spin-offs that benefit everyday consumers.

title: ultra-compact micro-sensor
meaning_vi: cảm biến siêu nhỏ gọn

examples.en: Publicly funded laboratories developed an ultra-compact micro-sensor that is now used in hospital monitoring equipment.

title: a more impactful solution
meaning_vi: một giải pháp có tác động hơn

examples.en: Rather than cutting taxes, subsidising public transport might be a more impactful solution to congestion.

title: extreme cases
meaning_vi: những trường hợp cực đoan

examples.en: In extreme cases, the government may need to intervene directly to prevent a market collapse.

title: allocation for the army or weapons
term: allocation for the army or weapons
meaning_vi: phân bổ ngân sách cho quân đội hoặc vũ khí

examples.en: Peace activists have long campaigned for a smaller allocation for the army or weapons and greater spending on welfare.

title: assimilation
meaning_vi: sự đồng hóa, hòa nhập

examples.en: Without clear legal frameworks, the assimilation of migrant workers into the formal economy remains slow.

title: governmental restrictions
meaning_vi: các hạn chế của chính phủ

examples.en: Strict governmental restrictions on internet use have driven many businesses to relocate abroad.

title: have no means of expressing a collective identity
term: have no means of expressing a collective identity
pronunciation: /hæv nəʊ miːnz əv ɪkˈspresɪŋ ə kəˈlektɪv aɪˈdentɪti/
meaning_vi: không có phương tiện để thể hiện bản sắc tập thể

examples.en: Critics warn that if traditional festivals disappear, communities will have no means of expressing a collective identity.

title: see ourselves within a larger context
term: see ourselves within a larger context
meaning_vi: nhìn nhận bản thân trong một bối cảnh lớn hơn

examples.en: Studying history and the arts helps us see ourselves within a larger context of human civilisation.

title: decriminalized
meaning_vi: (adjective (past participle)). được phi hình sự hóa

examples.en: Several countries have decriminalized minor drug possession in favour of public health interventions.

title: curbing their domestic issues
meaning_vi: kiềm chế các vấn đề trong nước

examples.en: Some politicians insist that curbing their domestic issues should take precedence over sending aid abroad.

title: determining national priority on internal problems
term: determining national priority on internal problems
meaning_vi: xác định ưu tiên quốc gia đối với các vấn đề nội bộ

examples.en: Determining national priority on internal problems often shapes how much a country spends on foreign assistance.

title: a commonplace
meaning_vi: điều phổ biến, thông thường

examples.en: It has become a commonplace for developed nations to send foreign aid whenever a natural disaster strikes.

title: developed countries
meaning_vi: các nước phát triển

examples.en: Developed countries are increasingly being asked to share the financial burden of tackling climate change.

title: have clearly defined borders
meaning_vi: có biên giới được xác định rõ ràng

examples.en: Territorial disputes are less likely when neighbouring countries have clearly defined borders.

title: impoverished
meaning_vi: nghèo khó

examples.en: Emergency food shipments were sent to impoverished regions following the prolonged drought.

title: low-income nations
meaning_vi: các quốc gia thu nhập thấp

examples.en: Wealthy countries have been urged to cancel the debts owed by several low-income nations.

title: refugees
meaning_vi: người tị nạn

examples.en: The government pledged additional funding to shelter and resettle refugees fleeing conflict.

title: the technological realm
meaning_vi: lĩnh vực công nghệ

examples.en: Progress in the technological realm has made it easier to deliver medical supplies to remote areas.

title: transnational commerce
meaning_vi: thương mại xuyên quốc gia

examples.en: Advances in shipping technology have made transnational commerce faster and more cost-effective than ever.

title: a symbol of humanity
meaning_vi: biểu tượng của lòng nhân đạo

examples.en: The rapid deployment of rescue teams abroad was seen as a symbol of humanity transcending politics.

title: detrimental impacts on local culture
meaning_vi: tác động bất lợi đến văn hóa địa phương

examples.en: Opponents argue that unchecked foreign trade can have detrimental impacts on local culture and traditions.

title: economic inequalities
meaning_vi: bất bình đẳng kinh tế

examples.en: Global economic inequalities have widened significantly over the past two decades despite aid programmes.

title: exacerbating existing challenges
meaning_vi: làm trầm trọng thêm những thách thức hiện có

examples.en: Cutting foreign aid budgets risks exacerbating existing challenges faced by the world's poorest nations.

title: generating more profit
meaning_vi: tạo ra nhiều lợi nhuận hơn

examples.en: Free trade zones allow exporters to cut costs, generating more profit for local manufacturers.

title: illegal migration
meaning_vi: di cư bất hợp pháp

examples.en: Tighter border controls were introduced in response to rising illegal migration across the region.

title: political instability
meaning_vi: sự bất ổn chính trị

examples.en: Prolonged political instability has discouraged foreign investors from entering the region.

title: produce goodwill between countries
meaning_vi: tạo thiện chí giữa các quốc gia

examples.en: Joint disaster-relief efforts can produce goodwill between countries that once had strained relations.

title: stimulates importing and exporting activities
meaning_vi: kích thích các hoạt động xuất nhập khẩu

examples.en: Cutting red tape at customs stimulates importing and exporting activities, boosting the national economy.

title: unrestrictedly cross-border trading of products
meaning_vi: hoạt động thương mại xuyên biên giới không hạn chế

examples.en: Some economists warn that unrestrictedly cross-border trading of products could undermine local industries.

title: address the specific needs
meaning_vi: đáp ứng những nhu cầu cụ thể

examples.en: Aid programmes are most effective when they address the specific needs of each recipient community.

title: commercial freedom
meaning_vi: tự do thương mại

examples.en: By lowering tariffs, the new agreement grants businesses far greater commercial freedom to trade across borders.

title: creating sustainable change
meaning_vi: tạo ra sự thay đổi bền vững

examples.en: Rather than offering one-off donations, agencies now focus on creating sustainable change through education.

title: crossborder support
meaning_vi: sự hỗ trợ xuyên biên giới

examples.en: Crossborder support during humanitarian crises demonstrates that solidarity can transcend national boundaries.

title: fostering mutual understanding and cooperation
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy sự hiểu biết và hợp tác lẫn nhau

examples.en: Cultural exchange programmes are valuable for fostering mutual understanding and cooperation between nations.

title: humanitarian relief program
meaning_vi: chương trình cứu trợ nhân đạo

examples.en: The government pledged additional funding to expand its humanitarian relief program in earthquake-affected regions abroad.

title: lend their assistance to citizens within their jurisdiction
term: lend their assistance to citizens within their jurisdiction
pronunciation: /lend ðeər əˈsɪstəns tə ˈsɪtɪzənz wɪˈðɪn ðeə ˌdʒʊərɪsˈdɪkʃn/
meaning_vi: hỗ trợ công dân trong phạm vi quyền hạn của mình

examples.en: National governments are best placed to lend their assistance to citizens within their jurisdiction during emergencies.

title: mitigating
meaning_vi: giảm thiểu

examples.en: International cooperation plays a vital role in mitigating the effects of climate change on vulnerable nations.

title: monetary aid
meaning_vi: viện trợ tiền tệ

examples.en: Some economists claim that monetary aid alone cannot lift a nation out of poverty without institutional reform.

title: praiseworthy action
meaning_vi: hành động đáng khen ngợi

examples.en: Diplomats described the ceasefire negotiations as a praiseworthy action that prevented further bloodshed.

title: reduce immigration
meaning_vi: giảm nhập cư

examples.en: Supporting economic development abroad may help reduce immigration driven by poverty.

title: support weaker states
meaning_vi: hỗ trợ các quốc gia yếu hơn

examples.en: Wealthier nations have a moral obligation to support weaker states through foreign aid programmes.

title: to battle poverty effectively
meaning_vi: chống đói nghèo một cách hiệu quả

examples.en: Governments need long-term strategies to battle poverty effectively rather than relying on short-term handouts.

title: to promote domestic and international economy
term: to promote domestic and international economy
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy nền kinh tế trong nước và quốc tế

examples.en: Free trade agreements are often designed to promote domestic and international economy simultaneously.

title: paramount
meaning_vi: tối quan trọng

examples.en: Transparency in government spending is paramount if public trust is to be maintained.

title: hinder a nation's overall development
meaning_vi: cản trở sự phát triển tổng thể của một quốc gia

examples.en: Endemic corruption can hinder a nation's overall development for generations.

title: smuggling
meaning_vi: buôn lậu

examples.en: Stricter customs regulations were introduced to curb the smuggling of counterfeit goods across the border.

title: the proliferation of illegal trading
meaning_vi: sự lan rộng của hoạt động buôn bán bất hợp pháp

examples.en: Weak border enforcement has led to the proliferation of illegal trading in endangered wildlife.

title: fosters greater accountability
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy trách nhiệm giải trình cao hơn

examples.en: Publishing detailed budget reports fosters greater accountability within government spending departments.
